heading: The Environment
text: We want you to be able to produce your best work here at Shopify. You can wear whatever clothing you like, start work late in the morning, and play video games whenever you need a break. The office is also located in the trendy Ottawa market so there are lots of cool places to eat and play after work.
label: benefits_perks

heading: Here’s some advice to get you started
text: “Don’t worry about what you don’t know. Show us that you’re eager and ready to learn.” Gillian Massel Summer 2015, now full-time “You can show that you are a fun and interesting person. It’s all the different and quirky personalities here at Shopify which makes it such a great workplace!” Jonathan Smith Summer & Fall 2015 “For technical interviews, don’t fixate on solving the problem correctly. How you approach the problem and what you do when you get stuck are equally important.” Michael Lutaaya Summer & Fall 2014, 2015 “Do your homework on Shopify and the role. Be authentic. Show us what you’re passionate about, and don’t be nervous! It’s just a casual conversation.” Jess Verbruggen Summer & Fall 2015, now full-time

heading: Notice to UK, EEA, AU, and California Candidates
text: You have rights to correct, update, and request access to your personal information and information about our processing of your personal information; request rectification of your personal informaation held by us; request that we cease or suspend the processing your personal information; request that we delete your personal information; request that we port your personal information to another service provider; request that we restrict our processing of your personal information (including limiting the use of sensitive personal information, as applicable); object to certain processing activities (e.g. profiling activities based on our legitimate interests, automated decision making, etc.); lodge a complaint with the relevant data protection supervisory authority in your jurisdiction. In Ireland, the Data Protection Commission is the relevant supervisory authority. You can contact them using the contact information provided on their website. When Shopify has obtained your consent to process your personal information, under applicable law your consent may be withdrawn at any time with future effect. If this applies and you withdraw consent, it will not invalidate (1) the lawfulness of any processing Shopify conducted prior to the withdrawal, or (2) Shopify’s continued processing of some or all of your personal information under other legal bases, where applicable. Please note that we may need to verify your identity before facilitating or enabling you to exercise your personal information rights, and thus may request certain information from you when you submit any such requests. Under applicable law, you may also submit personal information requests through an authorized agent, in which case, we may request further information to verify the authenticity of the request and the agent’s authorization to act on your behalf.
